enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket over body. Place head on pillow. Remain lying. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Extend legs. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Move arm under pillow. Remain asleep. Turn onto back. Pull blanket up. Remain lying. Turn to left side. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs over edge of bed. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Lift toilet lid. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Close toilet lid. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast, microwave-heated food, tea from kettle)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and food container. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Open microwave. Place food container inside. Close microwave door. Press start button. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press kettle switch. Sit at table. Eat toast and food. Drink tea. Stand. Carry dishes to sink. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Open wardrobe. Take off sleepwear. Put on work shirt. Put on trousers. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place phone, wallet, and keys inside. Close bag. Turn off bedroom light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Leave apartment. Lock door. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press ground floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit on seat. Hold bag on lap. Look at phone. Stand. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to physiotherapy department.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing patients and running morning rehabilitation sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Enter physiotherapy department. Put on badge. Turn on computer. Open patient schedule. Walk to waiting area. Call patient name. Say 'Good morning, please come with me.' Guide patient to treatment room. Adjust treatment bed height. Assist patient onto bed. Demonstrate shoulder exercise. Count repetitions. Support patient's arm. Apply resistance band. Record range of motion. Type notes on computer. Walk to next patient. Repeat exercise session. Write progress note. Save file. Prepare handover sheet.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at the hospital cafeteria
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to hospital cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select salad and main dish. Place tray on counter. Pay at cashier. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Say 'Hi' to colleague. Eat salad. Eat main dish. Drink water. Talk with colleague about patient schedule. Stand. Pick up tray. Carry tray to return station. Scrape food scraps. Place tray on stack. Walk out of cafeteria. Walk back to department.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist: afternoon therapy sessions, patient notes and handover preparation
enriched_activities.desc: Enter treatment room. Greet patient. Adjust parallel bars. Assist patient in standing. Guide gait training. Hold gait belt. Count steps. Correct foot placement. Assist patient to sit. Measure knee flexion. Apply ice pack. Set timer. Remove ice pack. Type session notes. Enter progress data. Save file. Print handover summary. Meet nurse. Give handover sheet. Walk to locker.

Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit on seat. Place bag on lap. Look at phone. Stand. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to apartment building. Enter lobby. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to apartment door. Unlock door. Enter apartment. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and cooking dinner using the induction cooker and refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables and meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add salt. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Walk out of kitchen.

Sit at table. Pick up chopsticks. Eat rice. Eat meat and vegetables. Drink water. Stand. Carry plate to sink. Scrape leftovers into bin. Place plate in dishwasher. Place cup in dishwasher. Close dishwasher door. Press start button. Pick up cloth. Wipe table. Rinse cloth. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light and water heater. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Apply soap and shampoo. Wash body and hair. Rinse body and hair. Turn off shower tap. Dry body and hair with towel. Put on clean clothes. Turn off bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on living room light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Press channel button. Adjust volume. Place remote on sofa. Watch TV. Stand. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water bottle. Close refrigerator. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink water. Place bottle on table. Pick up remote. Press power button. Stand.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review rehabilitation research and plan tomorrow's patient exercises
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Turn on desk lamp. Sit on chair. Press computer power button. Type password. Open browser. Type rehabilitation research. Press enter. Click article link. Scroll page. Open document. Type exercise plan. Open calendar. Check tomorrow's schedule. Type patient names. Save document. Close browser. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand.

enriched_activities.activity: Light stretching and checking phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Turn on bedroom light. Pick up phone and unlock screen. Scroll screen. Place phone on nightstand. Stand on mat. Raise arms overhead. Bend forward. Stretch right leg. Stretch left leg. Lie on bed. Turn off bedroom light.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket over body. Place head on pillow. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Extend legs. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Move arm under pillow. Remain asleep. Turn onto back. Pull blanket up. Remain lying. Turn to left side. Remain asleep.
